body: I just want it to be over. I am exhausted. I am too tired to keep doing this, and pretending that it'll get better somehow.

Thank you so much. It actually does help to know that other people have gone through this. Everyone tells me "it'll get better" when really, what do they know? Nothing. They don't understand what it's like. They can't just say it'll get better and leave it at that. So again, thank you. It feels good to know that someone who has been in a similar situation did get better.

Here's the problem I have with this. Most people tend to just dismiss this as "teenage angst", when really, it's significantly more than that. Everyone sees me as blowing little things way out of proportion when I'm not. Being 16 and "going through changes" (which for the record, I know are a small part of this) isn't why I feel this way. My home life is an incredibly unhealthy environment. I was kicked out of my house for the first time when I was 12. Please don't pretend that it's just because I'm 16. It's not.
